sourceBasis: Owner-supplied images transcribed and cross-checked against PDF pages 14-16.
policy: Observed allocations are a screenshot snapshot with unknown capture time, not current holdings.
Targets are intentions; none is a broker write or instruction to rebalance.
Zero observed allocation does not establish permanent absence or present funding.
Quantities and blurred monetary values remain unknown.
Within-pie weights cannot establish whole-account exposures.
All security identities remain unresolved until verified against broker metadata.
Portfolio images supply initial seed provenance only, never current chart/engine evidence.
